_help: Windows version of ico-preview: previews .ico files with netpng's ico2png (github.com/tsnomura/netpng), which extracts the largest size in the icon as PNG. ico2png takes the input as a positional argument and writes the PNG to stdout, and Waydir runs generators without a shell, so ico-preview.ps1 (copy it next to this file) starts ico2png and copies its stdout into %OUTPUT% byte for byte. A PowerShell pipeline or > redirection can't be used for this: Windows PowerShell 5.1 re-encodes a native command's stdout as text, which corrupts binary PNG data. The script expects ico2png at %USERPROFILE%\.netpng\bin\ico2png.exe, where netpng's install.sh puts the real binaries; edit $exe in the script if yours lives elsewhere. On Linux/macOS use ico-preview.linux-macos.json instead. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
_help_args: Replace <GENERATORS_DIR> with your own generators folder's real path (shown live in Preferences → Quick Look → Preview generators), same as font-preview: there's no placeholder for 'this config's own folder'. Paths are passed as separate -InPath/-OutPath arguments, so spaces in file names are fine.
